header:
# Progress — run `agent-harness-2026-10-29-2` (agent-harness)

What this file is: the run's journal, rendered by the harness from `entries.jsonl` after every session, newest entry first. Each entry says what one session did, how it verified it, what it tried that failed, and what it asks Michael.

The spec is `docs/specs/2026-10-28-reliability.md`: R1 fixes the flaky checks at their cause (tests wait on conditions, `tests/run.sh --repeat` reproduces a flake), R2 keeps a session's entry (validator as the last step, a long summary trimmed, one resume for a missing entry), R3 closes the lanes-review leftovers and adds two lint rules, R4 gives questions a place to wait in `harness needs`. R1, R2 and R3 run side by side on two lanes; R4 waits for R2.

How to read the feature list (`feature_list.json`): array order is priority; `after` names what a feature really waits on; `passes` flips only when every step holds. Plans: `docs/plans/2026-10-29-R<n>-*.md`; reviews: `docs/plans/2026-10-29-R<n>-review.md`.

To steer: edit `INBOX.md` in this directory on branch `harness/agent-harness-2026-10-29-2` (first line `status: pause` or `status: stop`; answers under `## Answers`). The harness pulls before every session. Questions sessions asked are in `harness needs <run>` once R4 lands; until then in the entries below.

discoveries.text: The resume must be decided before the ingest (ingest appends the minimal line before exit 3) and outside record's lock (journal_ holds it; a 10m resume would stall the other lane): entry_resume runs in journal(), not journal_.
A trimmed summary of 400 + … (401) fails validate and readEntries drops it: cut to 399 + … as minimal() does.
validate's header message is the same for a long string and a non-string; R2-02 gives a long one 'header: <n> characters (at most 2000)' and validate exits 2 when only caps fail.
summary.mjs counts unmatched metrics rows as sessions; entry-resume rows must be filtered out of sessions and kept in cost (summary.mjs and metrics.mjs summary).
restrict commits a WIP first, so resumed.txt would be in history: drop the resume's uncommitted edits (checkout + clean outside .harness/runs) before restrict.
Check 25 (STUB_BAD_ENTRY=B) gets resumed after R2-04; its note becomes 'still invalid (...) after one resume'. STUB_PARK/STUB_INBOX_IN_COMMENT write no entry and will be resumed too.

proposed_changes: R2-01 step 2 says the resume is called from journal_ after an ingest exit 3; the plan calls entry_resume from journal before the ingest on the same condition (validate exit 1, not refused), because the ingest has appended the minimal line by exit 3 and journal_ holds the record lock.
R2-02 step 3 says the cut summary is '400 code points plus …' (401): readEntries would drop it; it should read '400 code points, … last' (399 + …).
R2-03 needs two small CLI additions the steps don't name: metrics.mjs cost <transcript> (the resume's budget) and metrics.mjs append-resume (the row).
